a Watch Emails module with a filter on attachments, so only real invoices enter the scenario
the entry node, classifying each arrival before the pipeline commits to processing it
a structured-output extraction returning typed invoice fields, with a confidence check before use
parse the PDF into a dict and coerce quantity, unit price, and total to numbers immediately
a Dataverse vendor table with a maintained-by-Finance form, not a spreadsheet on a share
a database node reading the vendor row, keyed on the vendor id rather than the display name
'Get items' filtered by PO number, with an explicit branch for no-PO-found
a 'Find Record' step on the PO table that fails loudly when the PO does not exist
a database read filtered by PO and line, returning zero rows when nothing was received
query receipts by PO line; treat an empty result as 'not received', never as zero quantity
Environment Variables or a config list holding the tolerance limits, owned by the Controller
a config dict with a version and an effective date, so an old run can be re-explained
a data store record read at the top of the scenario rather than a number typed into a filter
a 'Find Record' search by vendor and invoice number across the payments table
a database node with an index on vendor plus invoice number, so the lookback stays fast
build a match key from vendor, number, and amount, then check membership against the lookback window
a Search module on the composite key, routing any hit to the duplicate branch
join the three records on PO line and compute each variance once, storing it for the audit trail
a Merge node joining invoice, PO, and receipt, then a Code node computing the variances
join the three records and use a 'Condition' per field against the policy value
a 'Switch' setting the match status, so every invoice leaves with an explicit outcome
a Router with one filtered route per outcome, including the fall-through

a review app over the exceptions table, so the queue is worked where it lives
a 'Create Record' into the exceptions table plus a channel message naming the assignee
the clean branch that sets Approved and writes who or what approved it, and when
record the auto-approval with the rule version that granted it; straight-through still needs a trail
select approved invoices as of the cutoff and build the batch once, with a deterministic batch id
an Aggregator collecting approved items into a single batch payload
'Start and wait for an approval' on the batch summary, with the total and count in the card
an approval card showing the batch totals; the reply is stored against the run
assemble the payment file from the approved batch and log the response with the run id
an HTTP Request to the bank or ERP endpoint, with the credential stored, and the response persisted
'Create HTML table' of the paid invoices per vendor, then 'Send an email (V2)'
Formatter to build the per-vendor summary, then an email action
render one remittance per vendor from the batch, citing invoice numbers rather than restating amounts
'Create file' in a dated library plus 'Update item' to mark the batch archived
a storage module writing the retained batch that tomorrow's duplicate check reads
